title: From Frequency Bias to Spectral Balance: Operator-Aware Preconditioners for PINNs
summary: When neural networks (NNs) are used as a type of nonlinear parametric representation to solve partial differential equations (PDEs), they often display frequency-dependent learning dynamics that can differ from those seen in direct function approximation tasks, resulting from a balance between the frequency bias of the NN representation and that of the underlying differential operator.
